scope: Read-only classification of the 16 live direct child repositories for the W3 registry migration. No child file was changed.

validation.json_encoding: UTF-8 without BOM, LF, final newline

notes: For fa-ui-m8, the repository-owned application README and package manifest are under app/ and were treated as evidence for the parent repository, not as a separate target.
A missing pyproject.toml or package.json was recorded as absence; no substitute child source was inspected.
Direct .git directory presence was checked only to establish repository-root topology. Child branch, remote, dirty, workflow, CI, release, and delivery state were not inspected or interpreted.
inspection_boundary.source_set_hash: SHA-256 over the raw sha256sum output for the listed source_files, in listed order; source bytes were not normalized.

target_decision_rule.repository: An independently versioned direct child with its own .git directory and canonical direct-child path.
target_decision_rule.workspace_target: A non-repository root directory qualifies only when it needs independent selectable context, facets, tasks, or launcher targeting.
target_decision_rule.internal_path: A nested application or infrastructure directory owned by a child is never a repository and is not a workspace target without an independent selection need.
target_decision_rule.result: Keep exactly the 16 direct child repositories. Retire docker_compose and traefik as root registry aliases without creating workspace_targets. Keep fa-ui-m8/app internal and unregistered.

non_repository_shared_names.registry_action: Do not register; canonical workspace contracts live under .workspace/contracts/.
Do not register; workspace-owned schemas are control-plane files, not an independently versioned child.
